title: Rebels Take Damascus as Bashar al-Assad Flees
dek: An offensive led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham reaches the capital in 11 days and ends 54 years of Assad family rule.
body: Assad flew from Russia's Hmeimim base to Moscow and asylum. His father, Hafez al-Assad, had seized power in 1970.

panels.label: Assad's Foes Say
panels.text: Al-Sharaa says “a new history” is being written; Biden calls the fall “a fundamental act of justice.”

panels.label: Assad's Camp Says
panels.text: Khamenei calls it “a joint American and Zionist plot”; Assad says he never considered “stepping down.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side calls it justice, the other a foreign plot; at stake is whether Syria stays Iran and Russia’s corridor or answers to new patrons.
